# Scribes - The American Society of Legal Writers

> Scribes is the premier professional organization dedicated to advancing excellence in legal writing and communication.

Scribes brings together legal writers, judges, academics, and practitioners to promote clear, effective legal writing through membership, education, awards, and community engagement. The organization serves as a hub for legal writing professionals seeking to improve their craft and connect with peers in the legal community.
